book.name: Yohana
book.title: Malobhi Manyahi ngati moghalembakike na Yohana

content: Yesu abhalobhela bhabhulwa bhaki
Yesu paakajomwi kulongela malobhi ghanihagha, akalingali kunani kumahunde, na kupwagha, “Atati, lisaa lihikike. Undumbalyaje Mwana waku, nahuli najombi Mwana waku akulumbalyaje wehapa.
Ngati moumpeki lujiniku panani ja bhandu bhokapi, nahuli kwa bhokapi bhaumpekihe abhapekya womi wa mileli.
Na womi wa mileli nde ghongone, bhandu bhakumanya wehapa wa Chapanga wa kanjika wa chakaka, na Yesu Kristo joukantumike.
Nepani nukulumbalili pundema, nakabya nyomwile lihengu lela leukambekihe nilihengaje.
Sajenu Atati! Unumbalyaje nepani papamu na wehapa, kwa ulumbalilu ghola ghonakabhi naghu papamu na wehapa mangane ja kubhombakeka kwa ndema.”
“Nukutendiki umanyikanaje kwa bhandu bhala bhawambekihe pundema. Bhakabhi bhaku, ukambekihi nepani, na Lilobhi laku bhalijowine.
Sajenu bhamanyi kubha yokapi yewambekihe ihumiki kwaku.
Magambu malobhi ghala ghawambekihe nabhapekihi bhombi, na bhombi bhakaghajopalile. Na bhakamanyi chakaka kubha nakahumiki kwaku, na bhakahobhalili kubha wehapa nde wewandumike.”
Nepani nabhalobhela bhombi. Nepani ngachenulobhela ndema, nambu bhala bhaumbekihe, maghambu bhanihabha nde bhaku.
Bhokapi bhabhabhi bhangu nde bhaku, na bhabhabhi bhaku nde bhangu, nanatu numbaliwi mkati jabhu.

Nepani sajenu ngangubhi kabheti pundema, nambu bhombi bhakali bhabhi pundema, nanatu nhika kwaku. Atati Mhuhu, kwa makili gha lihina laku lewambekihe ubhalenda bhombi, nahuli bhabya chindu chimu ngati tepani motubhelile.
Panakabhi papamu nabhu pundema, nakabhalendiki kwa makili gha lihina laku lewambekihe, wala njeta jumu wabhu joakahobhike, nambu jola mwana wa kuhobha, nahuli Malembu Mahuhu ghatimilaje.
Na sajenu nhika kwaku, na malobhi ghangani naghalongela pundema, nahuli bhabya na chiheku changu chakabya chikamilike mkati jabhu.
Nepani nabhapeki lilobhi laku, na bhandu bha pundema bhatenda kubhahakalila, maghambu bhombi nga bha pundema ghoni, ngati nepani momeli nga wa pundema ghoni.
Nepani ngachenobha kubha ubhabhoha pundema, nambu ubhalenda na Mhakau jola.
Bhombi nga bha pundema ghoni, ngati nepani momeli nga wa pundema ghoni.
Ubhagholulaje kwa chakaka jela, lilobhi laku nde chakaka.
Ngati bhela mowandumi nepani pundema, nanatu bhelabhela nakabhatumiki bhombi pundema.
Na kwa ndandi jabhu niligholola namwete, nahuli nabhombi bhagholulikaje mu chakaka jela.
Wala nga bhanihabha pela bhanabhalobhela, nambu na bhala bhabhinhobhalyaje kwa ndandi ja lilobhi labhu.

Nobha nahuli bhokapi bhabya chindu chimu, ngati wehapa, Atati, moubheli mkati jangu, nanatu mkati jaku, bhanganya habha nabhombi bhabya mkati jitu. Nahuli bhandu bha pundema bhapata kuhobhalela kubha wehapa nde wewandumike.
Na ulumbalilu ghola ghowambeki nepani nabhapeki bhombi, nahuli bhabya chindu chimu ngati tepani motubheli chindu chimu.
Nepani mkati jabhu, na wehapa mkati jangu. Nahuli bhabya bhakamiliki mu chindu chimu. Nahuli bhandu bha pundema bhamanya kubha wehapa nde wewandumike, ubhapala bhombi ngati mowambali nepani.
“Atati, bhanihabha bhaumbekihe mbala bhabya papamu na nepani pokapi pamile, bhapata kuulinga ulumbalilu wangu ghoumbekihe. Maghambu ukambaliki mangani ja kutumbula kubhombakeka ndema.
Atati Wambone! Bhandu bha pundema ngachebhukumanye, nambu nepani nakakumanyi, nabhombi bhamanyiki kubha wehapa nde wewandumike.
Nanatu nilitendiki lihina laku limanyikanaje kwabhu, kabheti ananyendalyaje kulitenda limanyikanaje, nahuli upalu ghola ghowambaliki nepani ubya mkati jabhu, na nepani mya mkati jabhu.”
